title: Peru: Machu Picchu on the Inca Trail
summary: The Sacred Valley and the classic four-day Inca Trail, paced by a guide who knows the altitude better than the map does — ending at the Sun Gate.
highlights: Sunrise at Machu Picchu's Sun Gate
Cusco's San Pedro Market with a local guide

itinerary.title: Arrive & acclimatize
itinerary.description: Two nights in Cusco to adjust to altitude before the trail.

itinerary.title: Sacred Valley
itinerary.description: Weaving villages and Inca ruins on the way to the trailhead.

itinerary.title: The Inca Trail
itinerary.description: Four days on the classic trail, camping each night with a full support crew.

itinerary.title: Machu Picchu
itinerary.description: Arrival at the Sun Gate at dawn, then a full guided tour of the citadel.

itinerary.title: Depart Cusco
itinerary.description: A train back to Cusco and your transfer to the airport.

included: 8 nights across Cusco hotels and trail camping
A certified guide and full trekking support crew
All camping equipment and meals on the trail
Entrance to Machu Picchu and the return train
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
